product_baseline.rule: No product SHA is accepted as R40 baseline until Agent 2 publishes an explicit stable handoff/freeze. Observed moving SHAs are not baselines.

required_evidence_dependencies.name: local collection/project data contract and threat model

verdict_model.phase_pass_rule: All applicable automated and manual gates must be PASS on the same exact phase HEAD/tree; no FAIL, BLOCKED or PENDING_MANUAL may remain.

global_gates.name: Exact identity
global_gates.accept: Record base, HEAD, tree and changed files for the phase; recheck after QA.

global_gates.name: ES/EN equivalence
global_gates.accept: Public UI, help, errors, empty states, accessible names and navigation are available in both languages with equivalent behavior; no Spanish content leaks into English pages.

global_gates.name: 320px reflow
global_gates.accept: At 320 CSS px there is no two-dimensional scrolling for ordinary page content, clipped controls, hidden essential content or overlap.

global_gates.name: Zoom/reflow
global_gates.accept: Native browser zoom at 200% and 400% preserves content, operation, focus and reading order on representative affected surfaces.

global_gates.name: Text spacing
global_gates.accept: Applying the contract text-spacing profile causes no clipping, overlap, hidden content or loss of operation.

global_gates.name: Keyboard operation
global_gates.accept: All interactive functions are reachable and operable by keyboard without traps; logical order is preserved.

global_gates.name: Focus visibility and return
global_gates.accept: Focus is visibly perceivable, not obscured, and returns predictably after close/cancel/delete/import/reset actions.

global_gates.name: Forced colors
global_gates.accept: Controls, focus, selection, states and essential boundaries remain perceivable and operable with forced colors active.

global_gates.name: Reduced motion
global_gates.accept: Reduced-motion preference removes or simplifies non-essential movement without hiding state, breaking controls or changing task meaning.

global_gates.name: 44px internal target
global_gates.accept: Interactive controls introduced or materially modified by R40 have computed hit areas at least 44x44 CSS px.

global_gates.name: Progressive disclosure
global_gates.accept: Primary choices are shown first; advanced filters/options remain optional and reversible; phase-specific simultaneous-option limits are respected.

global_gates.name: Loading/empty/error
global_gates.accept: Loading, empty and recoverable error states are explicit, calm, understandable and do not trap focus or erase user work.

global_gates.name: Predictable navigation
global_gates.accept: Back/close/cancel/return behavior is consistent; user is not unexpectedly moved to another section or reset.

global_gates.name: No autoplay
global_gates.accept: No audio, video, animation sequence or timed experience starts before explicit user action.

global_gates.name: Audio controls and scene change
global_gates.accept: When audiovisual mode exists, mute, volume and image-only controls remain visible/operable; scene changes avoid abrupt audio/visual events and match reduced-motion behavior.

global_gates.name: Local privacy
global_gates.accept: Collections/projects stay local under the A5 contract, can be deleted, and are not sent to Sabik or external services.

global_gates.name: Provenance/licence
global_gates.accept: Every affected factual/media asset required by the phase is READY in A4/A7 evidence with source, date/version where applicable and usable licence/provenance.

global_gates.name: No pressure mechanics
global_gates.accept: No R40 surface introduces points, ranking, required streaks, countdown pressure or compulsory return behavior.

global_gates.name: axe supplemental
global_gates.accept: Affected surface has no new axe critical/serious violations attributable to the phase; this does not replace manual QA.

P0: Common card/component patterns exist without replacing global Iris shell.
Sortable full list/table, search and progressive filters are keyboard operable.
Mi colección is optional; project save/open follows A5 local-data contract.
Viewer/realistic experience has explicit loading, empty and error states.
No second parallel architecture or duplicated global Reading controls.
P1: Resources prioritizes practical tools; Taller/Intereses/Rincón are lower-hierarchy exploration links.
Games catalog content is preserved; no silent deletion.
Entry presents the approved simple question, search and exactly 9 primary contexts.
Age and type are behind progressive 'more options' behavior.
No points, time limit, ranking, pressure or competition.
P2: Primary explicit audiovisual activation exists in ES/EN with equivalent meaning.
Scene and its approved sound start only after activation and use A7 documented initial-volume token.
Mute, volume and image-only controls stay visible and keyboard operable.
Scene transitions follow A7 crossfade/fallback rules; reduced motion never disables controls.
Each scene has A4/A7 provenance/licence and textual alternative; no invented real-world sound claims.
P3: Taller landing shows exactly 6 approved areas rather than 25 simultaneous study cards.
Each study exposes the approved common pattern: free create / challenge, real tool, optional reversible level, help, save/open, export and link to Intereses where applicable.
Advanced capability means improved tools, not uncontrolled button proliferation.
P4: Intereses landing shows search and exactly 11 approved groups rather than 72 simultaneous cards.
Each interest follows the approved structure: explore, complete catalog, view/listen/simulate, optional collection, create in Taller, sources.
Cuaderno de Campo remains inside Tus intereses.
No Spanish content in English pages; factual/data content obeys A4 READY/HOLD.
P5: Explicit Intereses↔Taller↔Cuaderno links preserve context and provide a predictable way back.
Documented examples such as Trenes/Aves/Astronomía link only to existing or READY content; no fictitious real content is presented as fact.
Collection/project context is not transmitted externally when following connections.
Cross-feature navigation preserves language and user state unless a documented local reset is explicitly chosen.

automated: ES/EN route/string presence and selected behavior parity
network interception for local collection/project exfiltration
phase-specific visible-count assertions: P1=9 contexts, P3=6 areas, P4=11 groups
human_required: cognitive load and progressive disclosure judgement
absence of audiovisual surprise and suitability of scene transitions
legibility in forced colors/reduced motion beyond static assertions
mobile physical-device and assistive-technology checks when phase reaches final acceptance

phase_handoff_required.final_recheck: Remote/local HEAD and tree must be unchanged after all automated and manual QA.
